title: Pi service models registry
description: Shared <agent-dir>/extensions/service-models.json registry read by @saifymatteo/pi-decisions (classifier models) and @saifymatteo/pi-tts (tts models). A missing file or no model of a package's type leaves that package's tool unregistered.

$schema.description: Editor schema URL, ignored at runtime. Point it at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saifymatteo/pi-extensions/main/packages/pi-decisions/schemas/service-models.schema.json or the same path under packages/pi-tts.

providers.description: Service providers keyed by provider id. Tools address models as provider/model-id, so ids must not contain '/'.

provider.description: An OpenAI-compatible service endpoint and the models it serves.

baseUrl.description: Versioned http(s) base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1. Requests go to decisions (classifier) or audio/speech (tts) under it. Must not contain credentials, a query string or a fragment.

apiKey.description: API key, or an environment reference written as $NAME or ${NAME} (preferred over an embedded key). An empty string "" means keyless access (pi-tts; pi-decisions currently rejects an empty key). When omitted, the key comes from the provider id's entry in <agent-dir>/auth.json.

models.description: Models served by this provider. Model ids must be unique within the provider.

model.description: One model. type selects the package that uses it; api must match type.

id.description: Model id sent to the service and shown as provider/id.

type.description: classifier models are used by pi-decisions; tts models by pi-tts.

api.description: Wire protocol: openai-decisions for classifier models, openai-audio-speech for tts models.

description.description: Optional one-line strength hint shown to the agent in the tool's model parameter.

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens. Required for classifier models.

input.description: Accepted input kinds, non-empty and without duplicates. Required for classifier models.

cost.description: Optional per-token pricing; all values are finite non-negative numbers.

voice.description: Default voice for tts models; requests may override it. Not allowed on classifier models.

language.description: Default language for tts models; requests may override it. Not allowed on classifier models.
